summary: Wave 3 new scope: Request/Response core, route registration API, engine-free dispatcher with automatic responses, body ownership, response state machine and HttpAdapter SPI with in-memory adapter (T01,T02,T03,T05,T06,T07 in-memory).
key_entities: docs/api (request, response, routing, app, defaults, express-migration)
ambiguities: Exact internal package name of the RestApp implementation and test-fixtures harness API is not named by any decision (only 'internal package of NaruServe-api').
Whether the dispatcher's interim 500/abort/auto-finish behavior needs its own requirement or is folded into the dispatcher requirement (wave 4 replaces it).
Concrete SPI field/method names for raw path, raw query, extension points and two-call stop are unnamed; SRS must state them as behavior-level contract or leave to SDS.
Supersede of OPS-ROUTE-001 (verified) is a guarded mutation in the same wave; ordering relative to the new routing-docs requirement must be fixed during authoring.
